_extract.note: Complete reverse-audit extract for the Mailchimp v3 five-pack suite. Every official JSON operation is admitted exactly once. The raw Swagger exceeds the guarded marketplace fetch ceiling, so the packs omit an unusable openapi_source and this generator-verified hash-anchored extract proves the complete route and argument surface.
_extract.catalog_pin_note: The official 10722728-byte Swagger exceeds the 8388608-byte guarded document limit; a direct pin would fail before operation proof.

methods_parameters.note: Mailchimp documents count default 10, maximum 1000, offset default 0, and comma-separated partial-response fields.

quick_start.note: The API server prefix is account-specific. API-key requests use HTTP Basic auth with any non-empty username and the key as password.

_extract.unpaged_collection_note: These collection-shaped responses expose no usable continuation contract in the official Swagger. getAllLandingPages exposes count but no offset or cursor; the others expose neither. They remain callable one-dispatch operations and are deliberately not marked single_page, so the runtime does not make a false completeness claim.
